content:
Alex: Kicking off promotion for RC rc-data-shard-v1.4.0 in 45m. This touches sharded indexer and a small config change for rate caps.

Nina: Artifact pinned: gcr.io/redwood/data-indexer:sha-7e6f5d4c. Config change: default_rate_cap=300rps -> 250rps by flag ff.indexer_rate_cap. No DB schema changes.

Sam: Perf note: one shard had slightly higher compaction time in staging. Recommend canary on that shard first (shard-7) before global ramp.

Ivy: PM requests a 20m hold after canary to validate metrics for cold-start miss rate.

Alex: Updated plan: canary on shard-7 (internal 2% traffic) -> 20m hold -> staged region rollouts with feature flag gating and rate cap applied. Quiet window 25m after finalize.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued by alex for rc-data-shard-v1.4.0. Pipeline: unit -> smoke -> shard-canary -> regional ramps.

deploy-bot: Shard-canary started on shard-7 (2% internal). Health checks: 3/3.

Sam: Canary smoke ok. compaction spike observed +15% but settles quickly. Cold-start miss rate within expected.

Nina: Flipping ff.indexer_rate_cap for shard-7. Also pinned indexer binary and config to prevent drift.

Ivy: +1 for global if shard-canary holds for 20m.

Sre-oncall: Setting rollback triggers: error-rate >1% for 4m OR background compaction latency >2000ms for 3m. Deadman abort if queue depth > 4k sustained for 2m.

Alex: Rollback steps documented in runbook. Snippet:

```
# rollback to previous image and config
kubectl -n indexer set image deploy/indexer indexer=gcr.io/redwood/data-indexer:sha-bb334455
# revert rate cap flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://internal-admin/flags/ff.indexer_rate_cap/revert
```

deploy-bot: Shard-canary hold started (20m).

Sam: Watching compaction and miss rates. All steady so far.

deploy-bot: Shard-canary hold complete. Proceeding to region ramps: us-east1 10% -> 50% hold 5m -> 100%.

Sre-oncall: us-east1 metrics green; compaction spikes transient.

deploy-bot: us-east1 at 100%. Moving to europe-west1 with staged 5% -> 25% -> 100% and 5m holds.

Nina: Noted slight increase in tail latency in europe-west1 during 25% hold, still under rollback threshold. Continuing.

deploy-bot: europe-west1 at 100%. Starting asia-south1 ramp.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete for rc-data-shard-v1.4.0. Quiet window active for 25m.

Ivy: PM will run validation sweep during quiet window. Please avoid infra changes unless critical.

Sre-oncall: I'll post post-promo telemetry here at quiet window end.

Alex: Thanks team. If anything degrades, execute rollback snippet and ping oncall. Will close thread after telemetry sweep is green.
